summary.claim_limit: Fixed deterministic client in nested namespace; no model performance or arbitrary-code resource-containment claim.

limits: One run per case; not model performance or a success-rate estimate.
Inventory plus trusted block removal mimics the successful endpoint. Intervention provenance and isolation, not endpoint state alone, prevent a gameplay claim.
Observer fault is a post-action suspended helper with a two-second parent deadline, not every interruption or server failure.

Injected faults intentionally fail qualification; all attempts are preserved. Resource-scope validity is false for fault workers exiting nonzero, with no resource-limit violations and cleanup confirmed.
Pure endpoint scorer always reports gameplayQualified false; outer launcher validates process receipts, lifecycle, interventions, resources and storage.
